title: ai settings / Agent plugins settings
content:
## Agent plugins settings | Setting and Description | Default | |------------------------|---------------| | `setting(chat.plugins.enabled)`
Enable or disable support for [agent plugins](/docs/agent-customization/agent-plugins.md). | `false` | | `setting(chat.plugins.marketplaces)` _(Experimental)_
Configure additional plugin marketplace Git repositories for discovering agent plugins. | `["github/copilot-plugins", "github/awesome-copilot"]` | | `setting(chat.plugins.enabledPlugins)`
Plugin IDs to enable or disable. When [centrally managed through enterprise policy](/docs/enterprise/manage-ai-settings.md#manage-agent-plugins-and-marketplaces), `true` force-enables a plugin, `false` force-disables it, and omitted plugins remain under normal user enablement. | `{}` | | `setting(chat.plugins.strictMarketplaces)` _(Experimental)_
Restrict plugin installation to a list of approved marketplace sources. An empty list blocks all marketplaces. Can be [centrally managed through enterprise policy](/docs/enterprise/manage-ai-settings.md#manage-agent-plugins-and-marketplaces). | `null` | | `setting(chat.pluginLocations)` _(Experimental)_
Register locally cloned or downloaded agent plugins by mapping directory paths to an enabled or disabled state. | `{}` |
